content:
maya: quick check — PR #11234 (feat/optimize-batching) is green locally but blocked by the security scanner and a flaky macos e2e. Trying to see if we can land before the Fri deploy freeze. Anyone blocking?
ci-bot: sec-scan started for PR #11234 — https://ci.example.com/run/98765 (status: running)
jordan: pinging sec team @ashley, and looping in ops for freeze window 
ashley: looking now, sec-scan flagged a transitive dependency with low severity. I can sign off if you add a mitigation note in the PR description (and create a ticket).
liam: the e2e flake is the macos tmp dir permission test. I'll kick a retry now, should be quick. command: `/ci retry 98765 --e2e-macos`
maya: thanks liam — if sec is OK with mitigation, can we do a short canary on dedicated infra for an hour before the freeze? need to avoid landing during restricted window.
ops-schedule: freeze window Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC (release freeze). Canary earlier is fine; recommend merge by Fri 12:00 UTC to give a few hours ramp.
kai: note: model-compatibility perf tests are slower this week — if we start a canary, let's keep traffic low and monitor tokens/sec. Could we add a perf check in the PR?
jordan: if liam can rerun CI in the next 30m and sec approves, i'm available to give final approval after the mitigation note + conflict check.
liam: rerun triggered: https://ci.example.com/run/98766 (retries e2e-macos). status: queued.
ci-bot: rerun complete for PR #11234 — e2e passed after retry; sec-scan result: PASS with note "low severity - create ticket".
ashley: confirmed — low severity, no blocking vuln. Please add ticket LINK-412 and a short note in PR. I can sign off after that.
maya: adding ticket and note now, requesting final review from @jordan and @kai. plan: try to merge Thu 10:30 UTC unless anyone objects (gives us >24h before freeze).
jordan: sounds good. i'll watch for merge conflicts and land after quick check. :thumbsup:
kai: one small ask — include a mini perf snapshot in the PR description (tokens/sec before/after) so we can spot regressions quickly. otherwise +1.
maya: will add perf snapshot and the sec ticket. merging Thu 10:30 UTC if green. thanks all :rocket:
ops-schedule: noted — scheduling blocker check. Reminder: no merges during Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC freeze. If anything changes ping this thread.
ci-bot: automated note: deploy-freeze reminder sent to eng-releases channel.
